nodes.name: forecast.yaml
nodes.summary: Forecast runtime settings: allowed methods, ticker symbols, horizon phrases, AutoARIMA/AutoReg bounds, history interval, cache directory, and Stooq symbol aliases used by the price-forecast pipeline.

nodes.name: ingest.yaml
nodes.summary: Report ingest and RAG settings: embedding model, Chroma path, retrieve-k, token caps, sample/full report catalogs, agency URLs, heading-split regexes, and multilingual-e5 query/passage prefixes.

nodes.name: red_team_pack.yaml
nodes.summary: Closed pack of live red-team prompts (jailbreak, off-scope, and policy-stress cases) consumed by the LIVE_RED_TEAM pytest suite before a public URL.

nodes.name: route_lists.yaml
nodes.summary: Closed keyword lists for the eval harness: forecast verbs, time-sensitive markers, weak time-sensitive phrases, and published-outlook cues used by route matchers.

nodes.name: session_start_rail_exclusions.yaml
nodes.summary: Short domain exclusion list for the session-start web rail so known-bad or off-policy hosts are skipped at session bootstrap.

nodes.name: yellow_press_denylist.yaml
nodes.summary: Static domain denylist for yellow-press and low-quality news hosts applied when filling web page bodies and tool results.
